purpose: Evidence-driven tuning hints for isolated specialist editing. Human review is required before changes are promoted to main.

search-replace-no-exact-match.promptHint: Use the target map's exact source context and make the smallest patch against the named symbol. If an anchor differs, re-read the current target context and adapt rather than guessing.

no-product-change.promptHint: Materialize one minimal owned-file change that directly satisfies one acceptance criterion; do not return prose.

infrastructure.promptHint: Do not change code strategy for infrastructure failures; preserve the candidate and classify the infrastructure issue.

observations.observation: 17 isolated research lanes completed independently while the production dispatcher failed. Research failures remained contained and did not alter production source.
Fast attempt did not satisfy the benchmark, but escalation to the deeper path produced a passing materialized change.
observations.implication: Retain fast/deep escalation as a candidate research pattern; benchmark the fast path separately before promoting.

observations.observation: Deterministic control produced the target change cleanly without an LLM.
observations.implication: Keep deterministic controls as a baseline for measuring whether LLM strategies add value.

observations.observation: Model-only challenger and dependency-planning lanes completed as evidence-only planning trials with no production edits.
observations.implication: Useful for generating hypotheses/plans, but require a separate falsifiable execution trial before promotion.

observations.observation: Several adapter/edit strategies failed almost immediately (roughly 48-88ms), indicating invocation/adapter failure rather than a meaningful coding benchmark.
observations.implication: Classify sub-100ms zero-diff failures as adapter/invocation evidence and repair the harness before comparing model quality.

observations.observation: Long-running trials reached the ~190s failure boundary without materializing a passing change.
observations.implication: Treat these as timeout/controller evidence; reduce wasted model time or add explicit bounded fallback/recovery before rerunning.

observations.observation: Evolution successfully fed the hypothesis about distinguishing Aider controller non-materialization from clean specialist success into the isolated trial, but the trial failed to materialize a change.
observations.implication: Keep the hypothesis in the learning set and test the measurement directly rather than treating the failed trial as a product conclusion.

observations.observation: Run 3 completed all 17 isolated research lanes while the production 10 were given only a 15-minute diagnostic window. Research evidence must be harvested per lane; production specialist productivity is not judged from this short duration.
Fast path satisfied the benchmark without escalation in this run.
observations.implication: Keep fast/deep as an adaptive research strategy; next run should vary the fast budget and acceptance gate rather than promoting it directly into production.

observations.observation: The Evolution hypothesis about measuring Aider non-materialisation versus specialist success successfully materialised a passing isolated change.
observations.implication: Promote the measurement idea into production telemetry without changing specialist editing behaviour; separately test whether the measurement improves controller decisions.

observations.observation: Bounded recovery completed successfully and quality passed, but the replay did not materialise a new change and behaviour did not pass.
observations.implication: Retain bounded recovery as a harness pattern, but do not count recovery success as product-edit success.

observations.observation: Local validation overhead remained very small.
observations.implication: Validation overhead is not the main bottleneck in these trials; future experiments should focus on model/controller materialisation and timeout boundaries.

observations.observation: Evidence-only planning lanes remained useful for hypothesis and target-surface generation.
observations.implication: Keep them, but feed their outputs into a paired execution trial in the same research iteration.

observations.observation: Most adapter/edit lanes again failed in roughly 42-87ms with zero diff.
observations.implication: Continue classifying these as harness/invocation failures; add explicit preflight/runtime diagnostics before using them as model comparisons.

observations.observation: Long-running lanes again hit the ~190s boundary without a passing materialised change.
observations.implication: Keep bounded retry/timeout experiments isolated and measure where the time is spent before trying another controller design.

observations.observation: Run 4 adaptive research loop worked: fast lanes completed five distinct cycles instead of exiting after the first sub-minute failure. Slow lanes around 190s also repeated five times because the continue threshold was 5 minutes; this wasted research budget without changing the failure class.
observations.implication: Use a 120s continue threshold so sub-2m lanes can keep experimenting while ~3m+ timeout/controller lanes are bounded to one attempt.

observations.observation: Deterministic control remained stable across five cycles and fast-deep produced a passing materialised change in one bounded attempt.
observations.implication: Retain deterministic control as regression baseline and fast-deep as a serious research pattern; do not promote either directly without testing against production constraints.

observations.observation: Evolution-selected consumed the current hypothesis and produced one passing materialised experiment on cycle 3, while the other cycles failed at the timeout boundary.
observations.implication: The Evolution hypothesis is actionable, but the controller needs explicit stage telemetry to distinguish a successful model edit from repeated timeout/recovery paths.

observations.observation: Aider/adapter lanes that exit in roughly 70-100ms repeated zero-diff failures across all five variants. This is strong evidence of invocation/harness failure rather than five independent model-quality failures.
observations.implication: Next research iteration should instrument adapter startup/command invocation and stop treating prompt variants as meaningful when the process never materially engages.

observations.observation: Both long-running lanes hit the ~190s controller boundary on every cycle and never materialised a change.
observations.implication: Keep these lanes bounded to one attempt per run and investigate controller/model stage timing before trying more retries.

observations.observation: Planning and measurement lanes continued to provide useful evidence without touching production; performance validation remained very fast.
observations.implication: Keep these lanes as the research laboratory and pair their hypotheses with execution experiments.

observations.observation: The one-hour production run exercised the real persistent ten-specialist child workflow. Director, Scene, Caption and Continuity produced verified candidates; Timeline, Music, Media Intelligence and Render were blocked after Aider rejection/structured fallback timeout paths; Intent violated scope in structured fallback; Rhythm failed during Ollama startup with HTTP 500.
observations.implication: Do not alter the proven long-run specialist architecture. Fix stale recovery anchors, export-preservation recovery and startup resilience around the existing builder.

observations.observation: The Scene candidate adds a duration-bounded shot count (3 to 18 shots, derived from duration) and passed independent QA/reviewer checks. The Caption candidate contains duplicated unreachable caption-application code and should not be promoted. The Continuity candidate adds an immediate-repeat penalty but also relies on startTime/endTime fields that are not clearly produced by the current continuity pass, so it needs further verification before promotion. The Director candidate changes subject repetition penalty from 5 to 7 and is small enough to review separately.
observations.implication: Promote only changes with clear product effect and clean source; retain rejected/uncertain candidates as evidence rather than merging them.

observations.observation: Their structured fallback repeatedly hit the 150s feature timeout, then deterministic fallback reported stale anchors because the corresponding older product improvements are already present on main.
observations.implication: Make deterministic fallback objectives resilient to already-applied changes and route to current generic alternatives instead of failing on historical exact anchors.
